mapper.select: select event_code_id, event_type, event_code, event_name, notification_policy, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wf_bpmn_event_code order by event_type, event_code

select event_code_id, event_type, event_code, event_name, notification_policy, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wf_bpmn_event_code where event_type = #{eventType} and status = 'ENABLED' order by event_code

select event_code_id, event_type, event_code, event_name, notification_policy, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wf_bpmn_event_code where event_type = #{eventType} and event_code = #{eventCode}

select event_code_id, event_type, event_code, event_name, notification_policy, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wf_bpmn_event_code where event_code_id = #{eventCodeId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into wf_bpmn_event_code (event_type, event_code, event_name, notification_policy, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{eventType}, #{eventCode}, #{eventName}, #{notificationPolicy}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, current_timestamp(3), '', null)
mapper.update: update wf_bpmn_event_code set event_name = #{eventName}, notification_policy = #{notificationPolicy}, description = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = current_timestamp(3) where event_code_id = #{eventCodeId}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into wf_bpmn_event_audit (idempotency_key, deployment_id, process_instance_id, process_definition_id, execution_id, source_element_id, source_type, event_type, event_code, event_name, match_status, boundary_event_id, interrupting, message_summary, initiator_user_id, create_time) values (#{idempotencyKey}, #{deploymentId}, #{processInstanceId}, #{processDefinitionId}, #{executionId}, #{sourceElementId}, #{sourceType}, #{eventType}, #{eventCode}, #{eventName}, #{matchStatus}, #{boundaryEventId}, #{interrupting}, #{messageSummary}, #{initiatorUserId}, current_timestamp(3))
mapper.select: select audit_id from wf_bpmn_event_audit where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

select audit_id as auditId, process_instance_id as processInstanceId, process_definition_id as processDefinitionId, source_element_id as sourceElementId, source_type as sourceType, event_type as eventType, event_code as eventCode, event_name as eventName, match_status as matchStatus, boundary_event_id as boundaryEventId, interrupting, message_summary as messageSummary, create_time as createTime from wf_bpmn_event_audit order by audit_id desc limit 500

select n.notification_id as notificationId, a.audit_id as auditId, n.title, n.content, n.read_status as readStatus, n.create_time as createTime, n.read_time as readTime from wf_notification_inbox n join wf_notification_outbox o on o.outbox_id = n.outbox_id and o.source_type = 'BPMN_EVENT' join wf_bpmn_event_audit a on o.source_id = cast(a.audit_id as char) where n.recipient_user_id = cast(#{userId} as unsigned) order by n.notification_id desc limit 200
mapper.update: update wf_notification_inbox n join wf_notification_outbox o on o.outbox_id = n.outbox_id and o.source_type = 'BPMN_EVENT' set n.read_status = 'READ', n.read_time = current_timestamp(3) where n.notification_id = #{notificationId} and n.recipient_user_id = cast(#{userId} as unsigned) and n.read_status = 'UNREAD'
